from AlgorithmImports import *

class ParallelSlotsAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = [
            self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        ]

        self.spy = self.Symbol("SPY")
        self.aapl = self.Symbol("AAPL")

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        all_bars_present = all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols)

        if all_bars_present and not self.IsWarmingUp:
            spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
            aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

            indicators_ready = self.spy_sma.IsReady and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            history_ready = (
                self.previous_spy_close is not None
                and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
                and self.previous_aapl_close is not None
            )

            if indicators_ready and history_ready:
                spy_crosses_above = (
                    self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                    and spy_close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
                )
                spy_crosses_below = (
                    self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                    and spy_close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value
                )

                # Sell rules are evaluated before buy rules.
                if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = 0

                if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = 0

                if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
                    shares = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) // spy_close)
                    if shares > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                        self.strategy_a_lot = shares

                if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
                    if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                        shares = int(20_000 // aapl_close)
                        if shares > 0:
                            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                            self.strategy_b_lot = shares

        # Market-state values continue updating whenever their own bars exist.
        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy) and self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            self.previous_spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
            self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close
            if self.previous_aapl_close is None:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            elif aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

class ParallelSmaRsiStrategies(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](101)
        self.aapl_closes = RollingWindow[float](4)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            self.spy_closes.Add(float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close))

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            aapl_close = float(data.Bars[self.aapl].Close)

            if self.aapl_closes.Count > 0:
                if aapl_close < self.aapl_closes[0]:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_closes.Add(aapl_close)

        if not all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        if not self.spy_closes.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            return

        spy_close = float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close)
        aapl_close = float(data.Bars[self.aapl].Close)

        today_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(100)) / 100.0
        yesterday_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 101)) / 100.0
        yesterday_spy_close = self.spy_closes[1]

        spy_crosses_above = (
            yesterday_spy_close <= yesterday_sma and
            spy_close > today_sma
        )
        spy_crosses_below = (
            yesterday_spy_close >= yesterday_sma and
            spy_close < today_sma
        )

        # Evaluate sells before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
            shares = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_close)
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = shares

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                shares = int(20000 / aapl_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = shares

from AlgorithmImports import *
from collections import deque


class ExactStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_closes_for_sma = deque(maxlen=100)
        self.spy_recent_closes = deque(maxlen=2)
        self.spy_sma = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None

        self.aapl_recent_closes = deque(maxlen=2)
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        # Private lots for the two independent slots.
        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        # Market-state quantities update continuously whenever their bar exists.
        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close

            self.spy_recent_closes.append(spy_close)
            self.spy_closes_for_sma.append(spy_close)

            if len(self.spy_closes_for_sma) == 100:
                self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma
                self.spy_sma = sum(self.spy_closes_for_sma) / 100.0

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

            self.aapl_recent_closes.append(aapl_close)

            if len(self.aapl_recent_closes) == 2:
                if self.aapl_recent_closes[-1] < self.aapl_recent_closes[-2]:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        # A missing bar for any subscribed ticker prevents all rule evaluation.
        if not all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.

        # Slot 1: Strategy A sell.
        if (
            self.strategy_a_lot > 0
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and len(self.spy_recent_closes) == 2
            and self.spy_recent_closes[-2] >= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close < self.spy_sma
        ):
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        # Slot 2: Strategy B sell.
        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        # Slot 1: Strategy A buy.
        if (
            self.strategy_a_lot == 0
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and len(self.spy_recent_closes) == 2
            and self.spy_recent_closes[-2] <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close > self.spy_sma
        ):
            quantity = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_close)

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        # Slot 2: Strategy B buy.
        if (
            self.strategy_b_lot == 0
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
            and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000
        ):
            quantity = int(20_000 / aapl_close)

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

from AlgorithmImports import *


class IndependentSlotsAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.spy_samples = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            self.spy_samples += 1

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            current_aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if current_aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = current_aapl_close

        if any(not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        if (
            self.spy_samples < 101
            or not self.spy_sma.IsReady
            or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            or self.previous_aapl_close is None
        ):
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

from AlgorithmImports import *


class PrivateLotsTemplateAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        bars = {}

        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if symbol in data.Bars:
                bars[symbol] = data.Bars[symbol]

        # Market-state quantities continue updating from any available bars.
        if self.spy in bars:
            spy_bar = bars[self.spy]
            self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)

        if self.aapl in bars:
            aapl_bar = bars[self.aapl]
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)

            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None and aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        # A missing bar for any subscribed ticker skips all rule evaluation.
        if len(bars) != len(self.symbols):
            self._store_previous_values(bars)
            return

        spy_bar = bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = bars[self.aapl]

        history_ready = (
            self.spy_sma.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_aapl_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
        )

        if history_ready:
            current_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

            # Sells before buys.
            if (
                self.strategy_a_lot > 0
                and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_bar.Close < current_sma
            ):
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                self.strategy_a_lot = 0

            if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
                self.strategy_b_lot = 0

            if (
                self.strategy_a_lot == 0
                and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_bar.Close > current_sma
            ):
                quantity = int(
                    float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) * 0.40 / float(spy_bar.Close)
                )
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

            if (
                self.strategy_b_lot == 0
                and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
                and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000
            ):
                quantity = int(20_000 / float(aapl_bar.Close))
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        self._store_previous_values(bars)

    def _store_previous_values(self, bars):
        if self.spy in bars:
            self.previous_spy_close = bars[self.spy].Close
            if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

        if self.aapl in bars:
            self.previous_aapl_close = bars[self.aapl].Close

class IndependentSmaAndRsiStrategies(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = [
            self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        ]

        self.spy = self.Symbol("SPY")
        self.aapl = self.Symbol("AAPL")

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0
        self.strategy_a_pending = None
        self.strategy_b_pending = None

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy] if self.spy in data.Bars else None
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl] if self.aapl in data.Bars else None

        prior_spy_close = self.previous_spy_close
        prior_spy_sma = self.previous_spy_sma

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None and aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

        all_bars_present = all(symbol in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols)

        if all_bars_present:
            spy_close = spy_bar.Close
            aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

            if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and self.strategy_a_pending is None:
                crosses_below = (
                    self.spy_sma.IsReady
                    and prior_spy_close is not None
                    and prior_spy_sma is not None
                    and prior_spy_close >= prior_spy_sma
                    and spy_close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value
                )

                if crosses_below:
                    ticket = self.MarketOrder(
                        self.spy,
                        -self.strategy_a_lot,
                        tag="Strategy A Sell"
                    )
                    self.strategy_a_pending = ticket.OrderId

            if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.strategy_b_pending is None:
                if self.aapl_rsi.IsReady and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
                    ticket = self.MarketOrder(
                        self.aapl,
                        -self.strategy_b_lot,
                        tag="Strategy B Sell"
                    )
                    self.strategy_b_pending = ticket.OrderId

            if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and self.strategy_a_pending is None:
                crosses_above = (
                    self.spy_sma.IsReady
                    and prior_spy_close is not None
                    and prior_spy_sma is not None
                    and prior_spy_close <= prior_spy_sma
                    and spy_close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
                )

                if crosses_above:
                    quantity = int((float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) * 0.40) / float(spy_close))
                    if quantity > 0:
                        ticket = self.MarketOrder(
                            self.spy,
                            quantity,
                            tag="Strategy A Buy"
                        )
                        self.strategy_a_pending = ticket.OrderId

            if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.strategy_b_pending is None:
                if (
                    self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
                    and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
                    and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000
                ):
                    quantity = int(20_000 / float(aapl_close))
                    if quantity > 0:
                        ticket = self.MarketOrder(
                            self.aapl,
                            quantity,
                            tag="Strategy B Buy"
                        )
                        self.strategy_b_pending = ticket.OrderId

        if spy_bar is not None and self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
            self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

    def OnOrderEvent(self, order_event):
        if order_event.Status in [OrderStatus.PartiallyFilled, OrderStatus.Filled]:
            if order_event.Symbol == self.spy:
                self.strategy_a_lot = max(
                    0,
                    self.strategy_a_lot + order_event.FillQuantity
                )
            elif order_event.Symbol == self.aapl:
                self.strategy_b_lot = max(
                    0,
                    self.strategy_b_lot + order_event.FillQuantity
                )

        if order_event.Status in [
            OrderStatus.Filled,
            OrderStatus.Canceled,
            OrderStatus.Invalid
        ]:
            if order_event.OrderId == self.strategy_a_pending:
                self.strategy_a_pending = None
            elif order_event.OrderId == self.strategy_b_pending:
                self.strategy_b_pending = None

        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_sma_ready = False

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
            self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            self.previous_sma_ready = self.spy_sma.IsReady
            self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

        if not all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        if not (self.spy_sma.IsReady and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady):
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close
        current_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

        spy_crosses_above = (
            self.previous_sma_ready
            and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close > current_sma
        )
        spy_crosses_below = (
            self.previous_sma_ready
            and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close < current_sma
        )

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
            shares = math.floor(
                float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40 / spy_close)
            )
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = shares

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            available_cash = self.Portfolio.CashBook["USD"].Amount
            if available_cash >= 20000:
                shares = math.floor(float(20000 / aapl_close))
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = shares
